title: About Charcoal Violet Occult Procession
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 73 recent saved-signal files and 59 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around multithread 02_Digital Occultism by Sophie Publig & Mikkel Rørbo and Anchor image material 8, plus 7 more. A source image from i.ytimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Charcoal Violet Occult Procession: Charcoal-violet nocturnal poster slab, poster crop composition, side-lit object slab grammar. Preserve a severe dark field with a top-heavy cropped white word-shape shadow, sparse violet occult-circuit hairlines, and one oversized off-frame right starburst as the lone rupture. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against upper off-white cropped type mass, central violet diagram node, and right crescent aperture edge.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
